title: Manyhands JSON v1 key mutation data
description: The data of a key select, key clear or key remove envelope. It may accompany any outcome: a success, a no-op, and a rejection that is about the key. A key command changes no canonical content and makes no commit, so every effect of its envelope is not_requested, and this and the outcome say what the request did. It holds no path, no key material and no passphrase.

id.description: The key the request is about: the one it selected or removed, or was refused for. Null for key clear, which names none.

label.description: The key's label, when the request read the key's registration. Null otherwise.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint the key's registration stores, when the request read the registration and it stores one. Null otherwise.

generation.description: Always null for key select, key clear and key remove.
